name: Cascadia
metaTitle: Cascadia Score Calculator (Wildlife, Habitats & Nature Tokens)
metaDescription: Free Cascadia score calculator for 1–4 players. Add bear, elk, salmon, hawk and fox points, habitat corridors, majority bonuses and nature tokens.
intro: Cascadia's scoring pad has a lot of boxes: five wildlife cards, five habitats, majority bonuses and nature tokens. Enter each player's points below and the calculator does the adding.

categories.label: Wildlife scoring cards
categories.help: Points from each wildlife scoring card in play, following the card you set up with (A, B, C or D).

categories.label: Largest habitat corridors
categories.help: For each habitat, the number of tiles in your largest connected group of that habitat. 1 point per tile.

categories.label: Habitat majority bonuses
categories.help: Bonus points for having the largest (or second-largest) corridor of a habitat compared with other players.

tiebreaker: If players are tied, the one with the most nature tokens left wins. If still tied, they share the victory.

rules.heading: How scoring works in Cascadia
body: Cascadia ends after the turn in which the last habitat tile is taken; every player gets 20 turns. Each player then scores their wildlife, their habitats and their leftover nature tokens.

rules.heading: Wildlife
body: At setup, one scoring card is chosen for each of the five animals: bear, elk, salmon, hawk and fox. Each card describes a pattern, such as pairs of bears or lines of elk, and how many points it is worth. Score each animal separately using its card and enter the five results.

rules.heading: Habitats and majority bonuses
body: For each of the five habitat types, find your largest group of connected tiles showing that habitat. You score 1 point per tile in that group. Only the largest group of each type counts.

In a game with 3 or 4 players, whoever has the largest group of a habitat also scores 3 bonus points, and second place scores 1. In a 2-player game, the largest group scores 2 bonus points. The rulebook gives reduced bonuses when players tie. Add all your bonuses together for the majority row.

rules.heading: Nature tokens
body: Nature tokens are earned by placing wildlife on keystone tiles. Each one you did not spend is worth 1 point at the end, and they also break ties.

faq.q: Do all my habitat groups score in Cascadia?
faq.a: No. Only your single largest connected group of each habitat type scores, at 1 point per tile.

faq.q: How much is a nature token worth?
faq.a: 1 point each if unspent at the end of the game.
The tied player with the most nature tokens wins; otherwise the victory is shared.
